item.title: Be sick on the rides in the Peter Mandelson theme park
item.description: Join the noble Lord Peter in his Prince of Darkness theme park in Islington, as he takes his country and party on a steep slide into the mud. Scream with disgust as you see him ride the vomit-inducing Gravy Train, the Kickback, the Double Cross, the Turncoat and the Sleazy Rider. Exit through the grift shop. image from pixabay www.newsbiscuit.com
